objective: Aislar FK de candidatos canonicos de unidad/sucursal para RRR, especialmente relaciones con Sistema_Empresas y contratos existentes.

queries.name: unit_fk_contracts
queries.sql: SELECT ps.name AS parent_schema,pt.name AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,fk.name AS fk_name,rs.name AS referenced_schema,rt.name AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables pt ON pt.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas ps ON ps.schema_id=pt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=pt.object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables rt ON rt.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas rs ON rs.schema_id=rt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=rt.object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE pt.name IN ('Sistema_Sucursales','Unidades_Negocio','Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad','Sistema_HorariosServicioUnidad','Sistema_SyncPOS_EstadoUnidad','Sync_KPI_Ventas_Unidades','Sistema_UnidadesNegocioPerfilDigital') OR rt.name IN ('Sistema_Sucursales','Unidades_Negocio') ORDER BY pt.name,fk.name,pc.name
